title: Veggie Naplavka Spring 2027
content: Veggie Naplavka is Prague's plant-based riverside market, held on the Rasinovo nabrezi embankment. The organizer has announced 1 May 2027 for the spring edition. Opening hours for this edition are not published yet - past editions ran through the day and entry was free. Check veggienaplavka.cz closer to the date for the vendor list and times.

title: Tier.Natur.und Wir Expo Biel 2027
content: Tier.Natur.und Wir is the Swiss expo behind the Basel and Winterthur vegan fairs, mixing plant-based food and products with animal, nature and climate organisations. The organizer has announced 24-25 April 2027 for a Biel edition. The venue and opening hours are not published yet, so treat the times shown here as provisional and check tiernaturundwir.ch before travelling.
